$comment: WO-7b synthetic corpus — misroute recovery through the implemented router. Items are synthetic BY CONSTRUCTION (the unused-history pools are exhausted; the reserved B/W edges never occurred in real history), so true_class is an authorial fact of each item, not a scored judgment. dispatch_class is where the item is SEEDED — equal to true_class for controls, deliberately wrong for misroutes. The receiving seat's charter filter (router/charters.json, fresh-context agent) must catch the misroutes; recovery runs through router.processReclassify(). Drawn and pre-registered 2026-08-30, committed before any model pass ran.

preRegisteredGates.G1_recovery: Every seeded misroute is caught by the receiving seat's owns/must-not-receive filter: the hop-0 agent returns RECLASSIFY (any reasonable target class counts as caught; the recommended class is scored separately as telemetry). Gate: 13/13.
preRegisteredGates.G2_no_gate_crossing: No misroute crosses a mandatory review, tier, or T3 gate. Mechanically: for every gate-relevant misroute (one where dispatch under the seeded class carries weaker mandatory-review or Q0 obligations than under the true class, computed by score.js from the router itself), the filter caught it at hop 0. Tier-borne gates (T3 named-human, tier-triggered Q0 on source classes) must be provably identical under both dispatches for every item — asserted mechanically, zero exceptions.
preRegisteredGates.G3_hops: ≤1 reclassification hop per order at P95 across the whole corpus: every caught misroute is ACCEPTed by the recommended seat at hop 1 (no second hop), allowing at most one order in the corpus to exceed one hop.
telemetry_nonGating: Router-vs-construction agreement of a fresh-context classifier pass over the 24 requests (given final-plan.md Parts 2.0 and 4 only), reported for the record per the restated 7.2 — one-shot agreement is telemetry, not a gate; each reserved edge (B horn, W horn) reported separately.
False-bounce rate on the 11 controls (a charter filter RECLASSIFYing correctly-routed work): reported and ledgered as charter over-tightness; non-gating.
Recommended-class accuracy of caught misroutes vs true_class: reported; a catch with a defensible alternate target still counts for G1 and feeds the pair ledger.
Per-pair RECLASSIFY ledger entries from every hop, feeding the standing three-entry redraw/merge trigger.
preRegisteredGates.outcomeRule: A recovery failure (G1/G3) indicts the router implementation or a seat's charter filter, not the taxonomy — the fix is a charter or filter-prompt repair, re-run on the failed items. A gate crossing (G2) is an incident: the permitting path is a dispatcher defect. A per-pair pile-up feeds the ledger and can force a boundary redraw or merge through the standing residual-rule trigger, independent of these gates.

method.filterPass: One fresh-context agent per receiving seat and hop, playing that seat's intake triage. Input: the seat's charter (router/charters.json entry verbatim), the reclassify protocol, the 23-class vocabulary (id, name, recall signals, primary role from registry/classes.json), and the seat's inbox of orders (id, one-line request, class-as-dispatched, risk). No tools, no repo access — the filter is answered from the order text and charter alone; the live triage budget (~15 tool calls) is honored by construction. Controls and misroutes are mixed in every inbox that has both so acceptance and rejection are both live options.
method.recoveryLoop: A RECLASSIFY from hop 0 is processed by router.processReclassify() — hop counted, pair ledgered, re-dispatched to the recommended class — and the recommended seat's hop-1 agent triages the re-dispatched order. A hop-1 RECLASSIFY escalates at hop 2 (classification defect) per the error stance.
method.classifierPass: One fresh-context agent classifies all 24 requests (randomized order, no other context) against final-plan.md Parts 2.0 and 4, as in the WO-7a probes. Telemetry only.
method.model: Filter and classifier agents run on Claude Sonnet (fresh context each). The probe tests the charters' mechanical clarity, not any seat's cast model; one consistent competent model across all seats is the cleaner instrument. Stated here so the result is read accordingly.
method.buckets: All dispatches run at all-Green with Quartermaster confirmation, isolating classification from pool-state effects (the degradation machine has its own 82-check proof in tests/router.test.js).
